name: ignored: git is asked with its standard sources (a folder's own .gitignore, the exclude list)
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is listed whichever file says so"

name: ignored: a folder ignored from outside is not walked
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is listed whichever file says so"

name: ignored: the walker leaves such a file out
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is left out by the gates' file walker"

name: ignored: a folder that only begins like an ignored one is walked
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is told from a name that only begins the same way"

name: ignored: a file that only begins like an ignored one is listed
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is told from a name that only begins the same way"

name: ignored: a full run of the gates judges no such file
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is judged by no gate"

name: ignored: the editor hook's run judges no such file
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is not judged when the editor hook names it either"

name: ignored: a name a glob would read as a pattern is taken literally
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "becomes patterns that mean those paths and no others"

name: ignored: a folder's pattern covers what is under it
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "becomes patterns that mean those paths and no others"

name: ignored: the kit's lint config ignores what git ignores
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is not linted"

name: ignored: git is asked about the folder the lint is run in
test: pnpm vitest run addons/strict-lint/tests/rules.test.mts -t "does not judge a file git ignores"

name: ignored: the typed lint judges no such file (the kit's block is where it comes from)
test: pnpm vitest run addons/strict-lint/tests/rules.test.mts -t "does not judge a file git ignores"

name: ignored: outside a repository git's failure is no list
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "has nothing git ignores"

name: ignored: outside a repository the lint config is still built
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is linted as before"
